skill.name: skill-seekers
skill.description: Convert documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDFs into Claude AI skill drafts.
skill.summary: Guidance for creating Claude AI skills from source documentation.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code. The two hardcoded URLs are source attribution and documentation links, not network calls or data transfer paths.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is frontmatter metadata that identifies the source repository. It does not instruct the agent to send data or perform a network request.
The URL is a documentation reference to the source repository. It is not executable code and does not create an exfiltration path.

content.value_statement: Creating AI skills from scattered source material takes time. Skill Seekers guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users through structured skill drafting.
actual_capabilities: Frames a workflow for converting documentation websites into Claude AI skills.
Supports planning skill drafts from GitHub repository content.
Supports planning skill drafts from PDF source material.
Provides guidance and patterns for skill authoring tasks.
Links to an external source repository for more project context.
limitations: Does not include executable conversion scripts or automation tools.
Does not validate generated skills against marketplace schemas.
Requires the user or agent to inspect source material separately.
Provides broad guidance rather than detailed implementation templates.

use_cases.title: Package Product Documentation
use_cases.description: Turn a product documentation site into a focused Claude skill draft for support or implementation tasks.

use_cases.title: Summarize Repository Knowledge
use_cases.description: Use repository documentation to outline a reusable skill for coding assistants.

use_cases.title: Convert Internal PDFs
use_cases.description: Transform process PDFs into skill instructions that help teams repeat documented workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Skill Seekers to draft a Claude skill from this documentation source. Include purpose, when to use it, and core instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Repository Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Skill Seekers to review this GitHub repository documentation and propose a skill structure for Claude Code users.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a PDF Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Skill Seekers to turn this PDF workflow into skill instructions, limits, and example user requests.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Marketplace Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Skill Seekers to improve this draft skill for marketplace readiness. Check clarity, scope, limitations, and practical prompts.

output_examples.input: A documentation site for a developer API.
output_examples.output: A concise skill outline with purpose, usage guidance, core instructions, and suggested prompt examples.

output_examples.input: A GitHub repository with setup and contribution guides.
output_examples.output: A skill draft that helps agents answer setup questions and follow repository contribution practices.

output_examples.input: A PDF that describes an internal review process.
output_examples.output: A reusable skill plan with workflow steps, boundaries, and example requests for team members.

best_practices: Start with sources that have clear procedures, reference material, or repeated user tasks.
Keep generated skill instructions narrow enough for reliable agent behavior.
Review every draft for accuracy before publishing or sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated instructions without checking source accuracy.
Do not include secrets, private links, or confidential documents in marketplace skills.
Do not turn broad documentation archives into unfocused skills.

faq.question: Does this skill run code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill file provides prompt guidance and does not include scripts or executable files.

faq.question: Can it create a complete marketplace package?
faq.answer: It can guide drafting, but users must still review structure, schema compliance, and publication requirements.

faq.question: Which source types does it mention?
faq.answer: It mentions documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDFs as source material for Claude AI skills.

faq.question: Is it useful with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can use the guidance to plan or edit skill files in a local workspace.

faq.question: Does it fetch external content automatically?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The skill only contains source links and general guidance.

faq.question: What should users verify before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should verify source accuracy, remove sensitive material, and test the generated skill instructions.
